title: Which model to use?
author: CTXBITXH
selftext:
Hello everyone,

i’ve been interested in game dev for years and was always trapped in tutorial hell. Finished one after another, never actually developing something from scratch. Once i had a foundation, it was really fun, but getting that foundation was really hard for me.

Fast forward to now and i have tried out GPT Plus with Sol 6.1 and i am blown away by the results. Working on a simple 3D-Tower Defense Game in Godot and i can use Codex to generate rigged models in Blender, import new scripts and generate Artworks as guide for the generated models.

I just work on some private projects, nothing commercial so far.

I have heard, that the undisputed king in coding is Claude with Opus 5.5. But, its also worse ar generating artworks and models.

So does it make that big of a difference? Is it worth switching over or should i just stay at GPT? 

Thanks yall for your input!
